title: Christmas in the City: A Private Minneapolis Walking Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Discover the city on a private tour made just for you. On this festive Christmas tour of Minneapolis, you'll get to experience all the magic and wonder of the holiday season. Your professional local guide will lead you to some of the city's most beautifully decorated locations, including CHS Field, Mears Park, and Union Depot. You'll be charmed by the holiday lights and decorations, and you'll learn all about the history and traditions of Christmas. One of the highlights of the tour will be a visit to the magical Christmas tree of Minneapolis, a towering tree adorned with sparkling lights and decorations. You'll learn about the history of the Christmas tree and the traditions that have developed around it. You'll also hear about the many miraculous Christmas legends that have originated in Minneapolis. So come and join us on this special Christmas tour of Minneapolis. Fill your heart with joy and experience the magic of the holiday season in this beautiful city.
